WERE OUTSIDE Anyway, here's a simple chocolate brownie recipe for you to enjoy: Ingredients: - 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar - 1/2 cup (115g) unsalted butter, melted - 2 large eggs - 1 teaspoon vanilla extract - 1/3 cup (40g) unsweetened cocoa powder - 1/2 cup (65g) all-purpose flour - 1/4 teaspoon salt - 1/4 teaspoon baking powder Instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour in an 8-inch square baking pan. In a large mixing bowl, combine the melted butter and sugar. Stir until well combined. Beat in the eggs, one at a time, then stir in the vanilla extract. Add the cocoa powder, flour, salt, and baking powder to the mixture. Stir until just combined. Be careful not to overmix. Pour the batter into the prepared baking pan and spread it out evenly. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with moist crumbs (not wet batter). Allow the brownies to cool in the pan before slicing and serving. Enjoy your delicious homemade chocolate brownies! Let me know if you need any further assistance. #summer #weoutside #single

Les ingrédients volent dans toutes les directions, rebondissent sur les surfaces et retombent naturellement dans les casseroles et les assiettes. Enchaînement continu de plusieurs acrobaties pendant la préparation, caméra dynamique, travellings rapides, ralentis aux moments les plus spectaculaires, vapeur réaliste, éclairage cinématographique et chute comique finale. Le personnage, son visage, ses vêtements et la cuisine restent cohérents pendant toute la scène. Aucun temps mort : une action spectaculaire dès la première seconde, puis une succession de mouvements jusqu'à la dernière image. Les acrobaties se déroulent à distance des flammes et des ustensiles tranchants, sans blessure ni accident.#AICast
